sloka: अत्र तावत् यथा बुद्धि सर्वैः एव यथा विधि ।भावस्य निश्चयः तावत् विज्ञेयो निपुणम् शनैः ॥४-३२-५॥
transliteration: atra tāvat yathā buddhi sarvaiḥ eva yathā vidhi ।bhāvasya niścayaḥ tāvat vijñeyo nipuṇam śanaiḥ ॥4-32-5॥

translations.english: 'In the meanwhile, (right now) all of you should think quietly and try to know the reason (for Lakshmana's anger), using your intellect and expertise logically and decide( the course of action).
